notes.title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 1 - Re: Raptored is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi there!

The good folks at Pedalboard Games have just released Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 1- Re-Raptored!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3830150/Creepy_Redneck_Dinosaur_Mansion_1_ReRaptored/"][/dynamiclink]Of course, the sequel to Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 wouldn't be what you exepected. (Or maybe you did? Did you expect this? If you did, you're gonna be...well, you're gonna be well happy!)

[previewyoutube="EFGd6Pujyf0;full"][/previewyoutube]

This is the culmination of something we’ve been wanting to do for a long time - Project Share!

“But what is Project Share?” I can sense you thinking as you read the above line. Well, if you scanned ahead you may have noticed I’m going to tell you - right now! This means we can share our developed knowledge, assets, technology and even IP with fellow developers we love to continue a series outside of ourselves. CRDM1 has been developed by Pedal Board Games, headed up by CRDM3 Project Co-Lead, Content Designer and Writer Colin McInerney. 

You can also save some money if you own CRDM3 with the Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion Franchise  Bundle! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59037/Creepy_Redneck_Dinosaur_Mansion_Franchise/"][/dynamiclink] 
Welcome back to the Mansion for the first time, again.

- Chris @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Splinter and Shredder are dead, and as the Turtles approach adulthood, they're not just growing up... they're growing apart.

We’re INCREDIBLY excited to announce that Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown is  OUT NOW! 

[previewyoutube=9wNkdfZQ1Es;full][/previewyoutube]
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown is our turn-based TMNT game. Inspired by the classic cartoon, you'll experience a new approach to the world of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles in this tactical brawler.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3229100/Teenage_Mutant_Ninja_Turtles_Tactical_Takedown/
This is a HUGE moment for us here at Strange Scaffold and we are so proud to get to work in the world of the Turtles! 

We hope you enjoy it, and if you do, tell a friend!

See you on the internet, 

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Update Notes May 21
notes.content: Just as small one today. Added in some missing pet photos from patrons for the "Cool Pics" encounter in Chapter 5.

notes.title: Update Notes May 17th
notes.content:
Today's patch includes:
- A fix for the text log background disappearing (if anyone gets any instances of this after this patch, please let us know) 
- Performance improvements in chapter 3
- A fix to the game's credits displaying at the wrong position
- Additional tutorialization

Thanks all. Have a good weekend!

notes.title: Update Notes for May 15th
notes.content: This patch should dramatically improve the stuttering issues that players have been experiencing, particularly on the map screen. Thanks all for sitting tight!

notes.title: Update Notes 2nd May
notes.content: Pretty straightforward patch this time - yesterday's update introduced a new issue where certain encounters would hang severely. This should be fixed now but do be sure to let us know if any issues persist. Have a good weekend!

notes.title: Update Notes May 1st BONUS
notes.content: A new freeze was quickly identified by players, which this additional patch should fix. As always we really appreciate how kindly people bring this stuff up. Thank you!

notes.title: Update Notes May 1st
notes.content:
Hi all! Today's update contains a mix of fixes and quality of life stuff.

Quality of Life:
- The game now tracks which options the player has chosen previously in dialogue and event encounters. The UI will slightly gray out options which have been chosen previously and text in the top right of the screen will notify you how many unselected options remain in an encounter. We hope this will help folks who are still missing the odd Trait or Item in a chapter (NOTE: this setting will be turned on by default for new players but is disabled by default for existing players - please enable it if you want it by ticking 'Track Unselected Choices' in the settings menu)

Fixes:
- Clearing horizontal and vertical lines with items like the Chainsaw should no longer bug out on button controls (like on Steamdeck/gamepad, as opposed to mouse input)
- Some more mended typos
- Progress trackers for the current chapter on the level select screen should more accurately reflect which traits and items are missing

notes.title: Update Notes April 26th
notes.content:
Continuing to sift through bugs that have been reported since launch. Thanks to everyone forwarding on any issues they're having! 

Today's patch includes:
- A fix for a sequence break in Clown Alley
- Exiting the game before the first bar/rest stop no longer allows the player to 'continue game' from the main menu into an incompatible save state
- Cursor position now reflects correctly on aspect ratios narrower than 16:9 (e.g.: 16:10 and 4:3)
- The application will now mute itself when minimized
- Typo fixed in the stress meter tutorial message

Looking into issues around the progression tracker next, among a couple other things, and should hopefully have fixes for those up around the beginning of next week. Have a good weekend!

notes.title: Update Notes April 24th
notes.content:
This is just a quick first patch to try and resolve some of the more pressing issues that have come up at launch. More fixes to come later!

Updates:
- Achievements should be fully working (and will apply for any you have already earned, you will not need to earn any again)
- Changes have been made to the save system, which we hope will resolve an issue some people experienced when changing their settings during encounters
- More aspect ratio options have been added to the settings

Thanks so much to everyone who has played so far!

notes.title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 is out now!
notes.content:
Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 is out now!

[previewyoutube=69Gn_8tCrMs;full][/previewyoutube]

Put on your most appropriate mansion-traversing boots and get ready to go on a one-of-a-kind adventure with J.J. Hardwell in Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3. We’ve discounted the game for launch - hopefully this can allow more folks the opportunity to celebrate with us!

Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 is a match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania. For a deeper lore dive, we invite you to check out this FAQ post we've put together.

We’ll see you in the mansion!

– Strange Scaffold

notes.title: The game is launching APRIL 22ND!
notes.content:
Hey friends!

We’re incredibly excited to announce that Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 will launch on April 22nd! 

[previewyoutube=Cf7l6vtDkxo;full][/previewyoutube]
This has been the passion, work and effort of many humans and we hope that you love what we’ve got for you. Really, there is some stuff in this game we can't wait for you to experience! Be sure to wishlist the game if you haven’t already to get notified when the game goes live!

Not long now, 

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Our first Demo is NOW LIVE for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey friends,

We're immensely excited to share our very first public demo for Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 - now LIVE for Steam Next Fest!

Featured in this demo are two chapters of goofy, heartfelt narrative, stylized illustrations, and beautiful, haunting polka beats from composer David Mason.

The entire team has been working hard to bring this demo to you all, and we can't wait to hear what you think.

If you check out the demo and have a nice time, please do wishlist to stay up-to-date with announcements and news of the game's release!

Happy matching,

- Strange Scaffold
